overview: The Mustang Report student broadcast recognized fall athletic teams and GBL All-Stars, announced the graduation speaker, and shared footage of student sports and activities.

items.title: Fall Sports and Graduation Announcements
items.summary: Dennis Robinson and Superintendent Roy Belson announced graduation speaker Andy Miller, recognized alumni award recipients, and honored boys and girls soccer GBL All-Stars.

items.title: Student Athletic Highlights
items.summary: The segment featured music montages alongside footage of cross-country runners and school events.
